chunks: Whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى: A transmitter appearing in the chain of narration
key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Ṣaffār, one of the transmitters in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s own route of narration
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ: A transmitter to whom this chain is being clarified

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh to Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ?
ai.summary: This passage records the transmission chain used by the author for narrations traced to Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ. Its significance lies in documenting the sanad/isnad structure of the book and clarifying the author’s route of transmission.
